verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent developer surfaces: an 'API Access & Keys' docs page and a 'Custom Agent Skill Developer Guide' for writing extension skills. Neither is an official client SDK, and probes found no published OpenAPI spec, so building would mean hand-coding against the raw API. Missing for 10: any official language SDK or client library, published API schema/OpenAPI spec, SDK reference docs, independent corroboration of developer usage.
